conditions.name: Acid Reflux / GERD
symptoms: regurgitation of food or sour liquid
worsening symptoms after meals or lying down

conditions.name: Appendicitis
symptoms: pain starting around navel then moving to lower right abdomen

conditions.name: Tension Headache
symptoms: tenderness in scalp, neck, and shoulder muscles
pressure on both sides of head

conditions.name: Lower Back Pain
symptoms: aching or stiffness in lower back

conditions.name: Sprain / Strain
symptoms: popping sensation at time of injury

conditions.name: Conjunctivitis (Pink Eye)
symptoms: redness in one or both eyes

conditions.name: Menstrual Cramps (Dysmenorrhea)
symptoms: pain radiating to lower back and thighs

conditions.name: Breast Pain (Mastalgia)
symptoms: pain in one or both breasts
pain that comes and goes with the menstrual cycle

conditions.name: Constipation
symptoms: fewer than 3 bowel movements per week

conditions.name: Pneumonia
symptoms: chest pain when breathing or coughing

conditions.name: Neck Pain
symptoms: pain radiating to shoulders or arms

conditions.name: Knee Pain
symptoms: pain in or around the knee

conditions.name: Eczema (Atopic Dermatitis)
symptoms: patches on hands, feet, ankles, wrists, neck, upper chest

conditions.name: Fungal Skin Infection
symptoms: red circular rash with clearing center
